rationale: Charter: attribute names must not collide with a differently-typed attribute of the same name on sibling types; such collisions caused silent data loss (0.1.11). Verified: accesscondition.source is a required string with no description, nine security siblings declare source as an optional 'Source code reference' object. Breaking fix (rename or retype).

rationale: Charter: composes runs whole -> part. A rule composes its conditions; accesscondition composes policyrule makes the condition the whole. adjudicated_by: claude, re-adjudicated against spec/DESIGN_CHARTER.md (adopted 2026-10-25); user approved the process

rationale: User adjudication (2026-10-26): an api.operation realizing an application function is a fair fit; the operation is the concrete exposure of behaviour the function describes, and the catalog declares exactly this triple. The sorting question (if an operation does not realize a function, what does?) found no better answer: Clef put none at 0.63 over api.operation 0.30 for the source and spread the destination across applicationcomponent 0.30, none 0.27 and applicationfunction 0.19, which is the signature of a judgment call rather than a defect. Kept as works_as_designed; the open design question is whether api.operation should also realize application.applicationservice.
